sections.title: Test setup and name pattern
sections.what: Brings in the test tool and sets a pattern that matches the five persona names.
sections.why: The name pattern lets the check confirm a speaker is one of the known personas.

sections.name: PAGES
sections.title: Checking AI labels on every persona page
sections.what: Visits each persona and roster page and checks that all voice blocks, persona chips and speaker names show the AI analyst label. Then it ticks each persona on the roster and checks the label appears with the persona name.
sections.why: Ensures disclosure is never missing on any page the user can reach.
sections.watch_out: Pages that show a persona without a voice block or chip would pass without being checked, so new layouts need new checks.

summary: Browser test that checks every place a persona speaks, or appears as a chip or roster name, carries the label AI analyst.
purpose: Makes sure users are never led to think a persona is a real person.
why: The app presents AI analysts with named personas, so the AI label is a clear-disclosure requirement that this test enforces.
how: It visits each roster and persona page. On each page it checks every voice block shows the AI analyst label, every persona chip contains that label, and every speaker name sits next to that label. It then opens the roster, ticks each persona in the switchboard, and checks the voice block shows that persona name followed by AI analyst.
inputs: The list of persona page paths, the persona names, and the roster switchboard.
outputs: Pass or fail for each page and each persona.
risks: If a page adds a persona name without the label, the test fails only when that page is in the list, so new pages must be added to the list.
debug: Find the page and element named in the failure. Check that the label text is exact and that the speaker name is inside the same block.
